facts.description:
View 4086 West 29th Avenue V6S 1V5 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 5 bed, 6 bath, 4289 Sq. Ft. house. 4086 West 29th Avenue is currently on market.
A custom-built home on a quiet block of West 29th Avenue, steps from St. George's School. Five bedrooms and six bathrooms across 4,289 square feet, on a 6,960 square foot lot.

The main floor is built for light and for entertaining. A formal living room sits around a full-height stone fireplace surround, and the kitchen is anchored by a large island with a dramatic stone feature wall and generous prep space. Wide-plank hardwood runs through the principal rooms, and the house is air conditioned throughout.

The lower level is what sets this one apart: a dedicated media room with a full projection screen and a large sectional, plus a separate bar and games area with room for a full-size table.

Upstairs, five bedrooms with good separation between them. The primary suite has a spa-standard ensuite with a frameless glass shower, deep soaking tub and double vanity. A covered deck off the main level looks out over the rear garden and mature trees.

The location is why this block is taken seriously. St. George's School is a short walk. Lord Byng Secondary, Queen Elizabeth Elementary, Crofton House and UBC are all within easy reach, with Dunbar's shops and transit minutes away.

In-unit laundry. Air conditioning. Garage plus driveway parking. Non-smoking. Available now, with lease term open to discussion. Please reach out to arrange a viewing.
